sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Tirumala Devi Eada
 Criminal Petition No.13936 Of 2025
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners-accused Nos.2 and 3 seeking to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.841 of 2024 on the file of learned VI Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, Uppal at L.B. Nagar, registered for the offences under Section 498A I.P.C. and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2.

entities.text: VI Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, Uppal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri V.N.R. Chaitanya, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1-State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that there are no specific allegations against the petitioners herein.
The petitioners herein are old aged parents of accused No.1 and parents-in-law of respondent No.2-de facto complainant.
The petitioners are facing false allegations in the hands of the de facto complainant.
He further submitted that both the petitioners never lived with the de facto complainant and never harassed her.
He, therefore, prayed to quash the proceedings in the present C.C. against the petitioners herein.
2 ETD,J 4.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that the petitioners' family was a joint family and all of them lived together.
He further submitted that the petitioners herein made the de facto complainant to write a note stating that she is not interested in conjugal life with accused No.1.

He,
therefore, prayed to dismiss the Criminal Petition.

5. Perused the record.
6.
There are specific allegations of harassment against the petitioners herein.

The contents of the complaint and the statement of LW.1 (de facto complainant) point out that the husband of the de facto complainant i.e., accused No.1 used to suspect her fidelity and used to say that the two children were not born through him and when she reported the same to the petitioners herein, they made her to execute an undertaking stating that she is not interested to lead conjugal life with accused No.1 and kept the said undertaking in their custody and further, harassed the de facto complainant and restrained her from speaking to anyone.
Finally, the petitioners along with accused No.1 necked out the de facto complainant from the marital home on 22.09.2022.
The truth or otherwise of the allegations would be 3 ETD,J culled out during the course of trial.
Hence, it is deemed appropriate to dispense with the attendance of the petitioners before the trial Court.
